links.text:
New Google DeepMind and Cambridge paper shows that an AI agent can discover new math itself, proving exact rules for 11 unsolved Turing machines.

AI can move from answering human-posed math questions to open-ended discovery, shown by a Gemini-based agent that found and Lean-verified new rules for 11 Busy Beaver machines with no prior documented analysis.

It tested edge cases in a simulator, drafts informal proofs, and then proves the rules in the Lean proof checker.
